extracted.intended_audience: applicants, IP practitioners, businesses and representatives filing or defending industrial property rights in Vietnam
extracted.subtask_description: Legal standards and procedural requirements under Vietnam law for establishing, maintaining, amending, terminating and invalidating industrial property rights (inventions, utility solutions, industrial designs, layout-designs, marks and geographical indications), and for preparing registration applications.

rubrics_metrics.name: Refusal ground: signs identical/similar to another's trade name
rubrics_metrics.description: Signs identical with or similar to another person’s trade name having been used if the use of such signs is likely to cause confusion to consumers as to the source of goods or services.

rubrics_metrics.name: Refusal ground: signs misleading as to geographical origin
rubrics_metrics.description: Signs identical with or similar to a geographical indication being protected if the use of such signs is likely to mislead consumers as to the geographical origin of goods.

rubrics_metrics.name: Refusal ground: signs identical/containing geographical indications for wines or spirits
rubrics_metrics.description: Signs identical with or containing geographical indications or being translated from the meaning or transcription of the geographical indication being protected with respect to wines or spirits if such signs have been registered for use with respect to wines and spirits not originating from the geographical area bearing such geographical indication.

rubrics_metrics.name: Refusal ground: signs identical/insignificantly different from prior industrial design
rubrics_metrics.description: Signs identical with or insignificantly different from another person’s industrial design having been protected on the basis of an industrial design registration application with filing date or priority date earlier than those of the mark registration application.

rubrics_metrics.name: Well-known mark criterion: consumer awareness (number aware)
rubrics_metrics.description: The number of the related consumers who are aware of the mark through purchase or use of the goods or services bearing the mark or through advertising.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: One of the factors to be taken into account when considering well-known status.

rubrics_metrics.name: Well-known mark criterion: territorial scope of circulation
rubrics_metrics.description: Territorial scope of circulation of the goods/services bearing the mark.

rubrics_metrics.name: Well-known mark criterion: turnover or volume of goods/services
rubrics_metrics.description: Turn-over of the sale or supply of the goods or services bearing the mark or the volume of the goods sold or the services supplied.

rubrics_metrics.name: Well-known mark criterion: period of continuous use
rubrics_metrics.description: The period of continuous use of the mark.

rubrics_metrics.name: Well-known mark criterion: widespread goodwill
rubrics_metrics.description: Widespread goodwill of the goods/services bearing the mark.

rubrics_metrics.name: Well-known mark criterion: number of countries granting protection
rubrics_metrics.description: Number of the countries granting protection to the mark.

rubrics_metrics.name: Well-known mark criterion: number of countries recognizing mark as well-known
rubrics_metrics.description: Number of the countries recognizing the mark as well known.

rubrics_metrics.name: Well-known mark criterion: value (assignment/licensing/investment)
rubrics_metrics.description: Value of assignment, licensing price, or the value of investment capital contribution in respect of the mark.

rubrics_metrics.name: Trade name eligibility requirement
rubrics_metrics.description: A trade name shall be eligible for protection if it is capable of distinguishing the business entity bearing such trade name from other business entities acting in the same field and locality of business.

rubrics_metrics.name: Trade names not protected: certain public or non-commercial designations
rubrics_metrics.description: Designations of State agencies, political organizations, socio-political organizations, social organizations, socio-professional organizations or those entities who are not engaged in business activities shall not be protected as trade names.

rubrics_metrics.name: Distinctiveness condition for trade names: proper name exception
rubrics_metrics.description: A trade name shall be considered distinctive if it consists of a proper name, except where it has been widely known as a result of use.

rubrics_metrics.name: Distinctiveness condition for trade names: no prior identical/confusingly similar trade name
rubrics_metrics.description: Not to be identical with or confusingly similar to a trade name having been used earlier by another person in the same field and locality of business.

rubrics_metrics.name: Distinctiveness condition for trade names: not identical/confusingly similar to prior mark/GI
rubrics_metrics.description: Not to be identical with or confusingly similar to another’s mark or a geographical indication having been protected before the date it is used.

rubrics_metrics.name: Geographical indication eligibility: origin requirement
rubrics_metrics.description: The product having the geographical indication originates from the area, locality, territory or country corresponding to such geographical indication.

rubrics_metrics.name: Geographical indication eligibility: reputation/quality/characteristics attributable to geography
rubrics_metrics.description: The product having the geographical indication has reputation, quality or characteristics essentially attributable to the geographical conditions of the area, locality, territory or country corresponding to such geographical indication.

rubrics_metrics.name: Geographical indications not protected: generic names
rubrics_metrics.description: Designations, indications having become generic names of goods in Vietnam shall not be protected as geographical indications.

rubrics_metrics.name: Geographical indications not protected: foreign GI not protected/used
rubrics_metrics.description: Geographical indications of a foreign country where it is not or no longer protected or no longer used shall not be protected.

rubrics_metrics.name: Geographical indications not protected: identical/similar to protected mark causing confusion
rubrics_metrics.description: Geographical indications identical with or similar to a mark having been protected if their use will cause confusion as to the origin of the products shall not be protected.

rubrics_metrics.name: Geographical indications not protected: misleading as to true origin
rubrics_metrics.description: Geographical indications misleading consumers as to the true geographical origin of products bearing such geographical indications shall not be protected.

rubrics_metrics.name: Reputation determination for GI products
rubrics_metrics.description: Reputation of the product having a geographical indication shall be determined on the basis of trust consumers have in the product through the extent of wideness to which it is known and selected by consumers.

rubrics_metrics.name: Quality and characteristics definition for GI products
rubrics_metrics.description: Quality and characteristics of the product having a geographical indication shall be defined by one or several qualitative, quantitative or physical, chemical, microbiological perceptible norms which shall be testable by technical means or experts with appropriate testing methods.

rubrics_metrics.name: Geographical conditions relevant to GI: natural and human factors
rubrics_metrics.description: Geographical conditions relevant to a geographical indication shall include natural and human factors attributable to the reputation, quality and characteristics of the product having the geographical indication.

rubrics_metrics.name: Natural factors relevant to GI
rubrics_metrics.description: Natural factors consist of those of climate, hydrograph, geology, terrain, ecological system and other natural conditions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Human factors relevant to GI
rubrics_metrics.description: Human factors consist of skills and expertise of producers, and such traditional production process of the locality.

rubrics_metrics.name: Geographical area determination for GI
rubrics_metrics.description: The geographical area corresponding to a geographical indication shall be accurately determined by words and a map.

rubrics_metrics.name: Business secret eligibility: novelty and secrecy
rubrics_metrics.description: A business secret shall be eligible for protection if it is neither common knowledge nor easily obtained.

rubrics_metrics.name: Business secret eligibility: commercial advantage
rubrics_metrics.description: A business secret shall be eligible for protection if it is capable, when being used in the business course, to render advantages to its holder over those who do not hold or use it.

rubrics_metrics.name: Business secret eligibility: owner keeps secret with necessary measures
rubrics_metrics.description: A business secret shall be eligible for protection if it is kept secret by its owner with necessary measures so that it shall neither be disclosed nor easily accessible.

rubrics_metrics.name: Information not protected as business secrets
rubrics_metrics.description: Personal status secrets, state management secrets, security and national defense secrets, and other confidential secret information irrelevant to business shall not be protected as business secrets.

rubrics_metrics.name: Right to registration of inventions/designs/layouts: authorship
rubrics_metrics.description: Authors who have created the invention, industrial design or layout design by his or her own efforts and expenses shall have the right to registration.

rubrics_metrics.name: Right to registration: organizations/individuals who invested funds
rubrics_metrics.description: Organizations or individuals who have invested funds and material facilities to the authors in the form of a job assignment or job hiring shall have the right to registration unless otherwise agreed and such agreements are not contrary to paragraph 2 (state-funded cases).

rubrics_metrics.name: Right to registration for state-funded inventions
rubrics_metrics.description: The Government shall provide for the right to registration of inventions, industrial designs and layout-designs created by using funds and material and technical facilities from the State budget.

rubrics_metrics.name: Right to registration for joint creators
rubrics_metrics.description: Where more than one organizations or individuals have jointly created or invested in the creation, those organizations or individuals shall all have the right to registration and such right shall only be exercised with their consensus.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Right may be assigned by written contract, inheritance, even after filing.

rubrics_metrics.name: Right to registration of a mark: producer/supplier
rubrics_metrics.description: An organization or individual shall have the right to registration of a mark to be used for goods or services he or she produced or supplied.

rubrics_metrics.name: Right to registration of a mark: reseller with permission
rubrics_metrics.description: An organization or individual legally engaged in the trade in a product produced by a third party shall have the right to registration of a mark to be used for the product, provided the producer neither uses such a mark for the product nor objects to such registration.

rubrics_metrics.name: Right to registration of collective mark
rubrics_metrics.description: A collective organization legally established shall have the right to registration of a collective mark to be used by its members in accordance with the rules on using collective mark.

rubrics_metrics.name: Right to registration of certification mark
rubrics_metrics.description: An organization with the function to control and certify the quality, characteristics, origin or other relevant criteria of goods or services shall have the right to registration of a certification mark provided that such organization is not engaged in the production or trade of such goods or services.

rubrics_metrics.name: Joint mark registration conditions
rubrics_metrics.description: Two or more organizations or individuals shall have the right to jointly register a mark in order to become co-owners provided that (a) the use is on behalf of all co-owners or for goods/services of which all co-owners are engaged, and (b) use shall not cause confusion to consumers as to the origin of goods or services.

rubrics_metrics.name: Assignment and transfer of registration rights
rubrics_metrics.description: A person who has the right to registration may assign that right to other organizations or individuals by written contract, by inheritance, even after filing, provided the assignee satisfies respective criteria.

rubrics_metrics.name: Restrictions on representatives registering marks under treaties
rubrics_metrics.description: Where a mark is protected in a member country of an international treaty which prohibits the representative or agent of a mark owner to register such mark, the representative or agent shall not be permitted to register such mark unless agreed by the owner or a legitimate reason exists.

rubrics_metrics.name: Right to register geographical indications: state ownership
rubrics_metrics.description: The right to register geographical indications of Vietnam belongs to the State; the State allows producers, collective organizations or local administrative authorities to exercise the right to register, but the registrant does not become the owner of the geographical indication.

rubrics_metrics.name: Mode of filing: who may file directly
rubrics_metrics.description: Organizations, individuals of Vietnam, foreign individuals permanently residing in Vietnam and foreign organizations and individuals having a production or trading establishment in Vietnam shall file applications either directly or through a lawful representative in Vietnam.

rubrics_metrics.name: Mode of filing: foreign filers without establishment must use representative
rubrics_metrics.description: Foreign individuals not permanently residing in Vietnam, foreign organizations and individuals not having a production or trading establishment in Vietnam shall file applications through a lawful representative in Vietnam.

rubrics_metrics.name: First-to-file principle
rubrics_metrics.description: Where multiple applications are filed for the same invention/design/mark for identical or similar goods/services, Protection Titles may only be granted to the valid application with the earliest date of priority or filing date among those satisfying all conditions for grant.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If multiple applications jointly meet conditions and have same earliest priority/filing date, a single Protection Title may be granted by agreement of applicants; lacking agreement, all such applications shall be refused.

rubrics_metrics.name: Priority claim conditions
rubrics_metrics.description: An applicant may claim priority on the basis of the first application if: (a) the first application filed in Vietnam or member country of treaty or country agreed with Vietnam; (b) the applicant is a national/resident or has establishment in Vietnam or that country; (c) the claim was clearly mentioned and a certified copy of the first application provided; (d) the application filed within treaty time limit.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Multiple priorities may be claimed for different earlier applications provided corresponding contents are indicated. A registration application enjoying priority bears the priority date identical with the first filing date.

rubrics_metrics.name: Contents of Protection Titles
rubrics_metrics.description: Protection Titles shall record the owners of inventions/designs/layouts/marks, the authors of inventions/designs/layouts, the subject matter, scope and term of protection.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For geographical indications, Protection Title must record management organization, organizations and individuals having right to use, protected GI, product characteristics, geographical conditions and geographical area.

rubrics_metrics.name: Types of Protection Titles
rubrics_metrics.description: Protection Titles include Invention Patent, Utility solution Patent, Industrial design Patent, Layout-design of semiconductor integrated circuit registration Certificate, Mark registration Certificate and Geographical indication registration Certificate.

rubrics_metrics.name: Validity: territorial effect
rubrics_metrics.description: Protection Titles have effect throughout territory of Vietnam.

rubrics_metrics.name: Validity: invention patent term (20 years)
rubrics_metrics.description: Invention Patents shall have validity beginning on the grant date and expiring at the end of 20 years as from the filing date.

rubrics_metrics.name: Validity: utility solution patent term (10 years)
rubrics_metrics.description: Utility solution Patents shall have validity beginning on the grant date and expiring at the end of 10 years as from the filing date.

rubrics_metrics.name: Validity: industrial design patent term and renewals (5 + two 5-year renewals)
rubrics_metrics.description: Industrial design Patents shall have validity beginning on the grant date and expiring at the end of 5 years as from the filing date and renewable for two consecutive terms of 5 years.

rubrics_metrics.name: Validity: layout-design of integrated circuit term
rubrics_metrics.description: Layout-design registration Certificates shall have validity beginning on the grant date and expiring at the earliest date among: (a) end of 10 years from filing date; (b) end of 10 years from first commercial exploitation anywhere by rights holder or licensee; (c) end of 15 years from creation date.

rubrics_metrics.name: Validity: mark registration term and renewal (10 years)
rubrics_metrics.description: Mark registration Certificates shall have the validity beginning on the granting date and expiring at the end of 10 years counted from the filing date and renewable indefinitely for consecutive terms of 10 years.

rubrics_metrics.name: Validity: geographical indication registration (indefinite)
rubrics_metrics.description: Geographical indication registration Certificates shall have indefinite validity beginning on the grant date.

rubrics_metrics.name: Maintenance and renewal fees requirement
rubrics_metrics.description: To maintain validity of an Invention Patent or Utility Solution Patent, its owner shall pay maintenance fees. To renew an Industrial Design Patent or a Mark registration Certificate, its owner shall pay renewal fees. Rates and procedures shall be provided by the Government.

rubrics_metrics.name: Termination of validity: non-payment of fees
rubrics_metrics.description: The validity of a Protection Title shall be terminated if its owner has not paid the due fees for the maintenance or renewal as prescribed.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If owner fails to pay before prescribed time limit, validity terminates ex-officio from first day of the year for which annual fees not paid and authority shall record and publish the termination.

rubrics_metrics.name: Termination of validity: owner relinquishes rights
rubrics_metrics.description: Validity terminates where its owner has declared to relinquish the rights conferred by the Protection Title.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Authority decides to terminate validity from date of receipt of declaration.

rubrics_metrics.name: Termination of validity: owner ceases to exist or is no longer engaged in business
rubrics_metrics.description: Validity terminates where its owner has no longer existed or the owner of a Mark registration Certificate has no longer engaged in business without a lawful successor.

rubrics_metrics.name: Termination of validity: non-use of mark for 5 consecutive years
rubrics_metrics.description: Validity terminates where the mark has not been used by its owner or his licensee without justifiable reasons for a term of 5 consecutive years prior to a request for termination, except if use is commenced or resumed at least 3 months before the request.

rubrics_metrics.name: Termination of validity: failure to supervise collective mark use
rubrics_metrics.description: For collective marks, termination where owner fails to supervise or ineffectively supervises implementation of rules on using collective mark.

rubrics_metrics.name: Termination of validity: certification mark violations/supervision failure
rubrics_metrics.description: For certification marks, termination where owner violates rules on using certification mark or fails to supervise or ineffectively supervises implementation of such rules.

rubrics_metrics.name: Termination of geographical indication validity due to change in geographical conditions
rubrics_metrics.description: Validity terminates where the geographical conditions attributable to the reputation, quality or characteristics of the product bearing a geographical indication have changed resulting in a loss of the reputation, quality or characteristics of the product.

rubrics_metrics.name: Right to request termination and decision process
rubrics_metrics.description: Any organizations or individuals may request authority to terminate validity in cases provided for (fees/charges paid). Based on examination and interested parties' opinions, authority shall make decision or refuse request.

rubrics_metrics.name: Invalidation: total invalidation grounds
rubrics_metrics.description: A Protection Title shall be entirely invalidated if (a) the applicant neither has right to registration nor was assigned such right; (b) the subject matter failed to satisfy protection conditions at grant date.

rubrics_metrics.name: Partial invalidation
rubrics_metrics.description: A Protection Title shall be partly invalidated if that part failed to satisfy the protection conditions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Right to request invalidation and time limits
rubrics_metrics.description: Any organizations or individuals have the right to request authority to invalidate a Protection Title in the provided cases (fees paid). The time period for making request for invalidation is its whole term of protection; for marks the time limit is 5 years from grant date except where grant was due to applicant’s dishonesty.

rubrics_metrics.name: Invalidation decision process
rubrics_metrics.description: Based on examination and interested parties' opinions, authority shall make either a decision or a notice of refusal to entirely or partly invalidate the Protection Title.

rubrics_metrics.name: Amendments allowed to Protection Titles by owner
rubrics_metrics.description: Owner may request amendments to: (a) changes/error corrections in name, address of author or owner; (b) amendments to description of characteristics, quality or geographical area for GI; (c) amendments to rules on using a collective mark or certification mark (fees payable).

rubrics_metrics.name: Authority correction of its own error
rubrics_metrics.description: At the owner's request, the authority shall correct an error caused by its fault in the Protection Title; in such case the owner is not liable for fees.

rubrics_metrics.name: Owner may request narrowing scope of Protection Title
rubrics_metrics.description: Owner has right to request authority to narrow scope of industrial property rights. The registration application shall be reexamined substantively and requestor shall pay substantive examination fees.

rubrics_metrics.name: National register content requirements
rubrics_metrics.description: National register for industrial property is a document recording establishment of, changes to, and transfers of industrial property rights. Decisions on grants, main contents of protection titles, amendments, termination, invalidation, transfers shall be recorded.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Register shall be set up and kept by the State administrative authority of industrial property rights.

rubrics_metrics.name: Publication requirement for decisions related to Protection Titles
rubrics_metrics.description: Any decisions on the grant, amendment, termination, invalidation, transfer of Protection Titles shall be published by the State administrative authority in the Industrial Property Official Gazette within 60 days from the date of decision.

rubrics_metrics.name: General requirements for industrial property registration applications (documents)
rubrics_metrics.description: An application consists of: (a) a request in prescribed form; (b) documents, samples, information identifying the industrial property object as provided in Articles 102–106; (c) power of attorneys if filed through representative; (d) documents evidencing right to registration if acquired from another person; (dd) documents evidencing priority right if claimed; (e) receipt of prescribed fees and charges.

rubrics_metrics.name: Language requirement for applications and communications
rubrics_metrics.description: Applications and communications shall be made in Vietnamese, except that certain documents (power of attorney, documents evidencing right to registration, documents evidencing priority, other supporting documents) may be in another language but must be translated into Vietnamese at authority request.

rubrics_metrics.name: Documents evidencing priority rights
rubrics_metrics.description: Documents evidencing priority rights shall include: (a) a copy of the first application(s) certified by the receiving office; (b) deed of assignment of priority rights if acquired from another person.

rubrics_metrics.name: Unity requirement: one Protection Title per single object
rubrics_metrics.description: Each registration application shall request only one Protection Title in respect of a single industrial property object, except specified cases.

rubrics_metrics.name: Unity exception: group of inventions forming one inventive idea
rubrics_metrics.description: Each registration application may request one Invention Patent or Utility Solution Patent in respect of a group of inventions that are closely linked to form a single common inventive idea.

rubrics_metrics.name: Unity exception: industrial design set or variants
rubrics_metrics.description: Each registration application may request one Industrial Design Patent for several industrial designs in cases of (a) set of articles expressing a single common inventive idea used together or for a single purpose; (b) an industrial design accompanied by one or more variants expressing a single common inventive idea and not significantly different from the principal design.

rubrics_metrics.name: Unity exception: one mark for multiple goods or services
rubrics_metrics.description: Each registration application may request one Mark registration Certificate in respect of one mark to be used for one or more different goods or services.

rubrics_metrics.name: Invention application: required documents (specification and abstract)
rubrics_metrics.description: Documents identifying the invention shall include a Specification of the invention and an Abstract consisting of a description of invention and a scope of protection of invention.

rubrics_metrics.name: Invention description requirements: sufficiency and clarity (enablement)
rubrics_metrics.description: The Description of invention shall sufficiently and clearly disclose the nature of the invention to the extent that such invention may be carried out by a person having ordinary knowledge in the art.

rubrics_metrics.name: Invention description: drawings explanation
rubrics_metrics.description: The Description shall briefly explain the drawings, if required to further clarify the nature of the invention.

rubrics_metrics.name: Invention description: clarify novelty, inventive step and industrial applicability
rubrics_metrics.description: The Description shall clarify the novelty, inventive step and susceptibility of industrial application of the invention.

rubrics_metrics.name: Scope of protection for inventions
rubrics_metrics.description: The Scope of protection shall be expressed as combination of technical features necessary and sufficient to identify the scope of rights and must be in line with the Specification and drawings.

rubrics_metrics.name: Abstract of invention requirement
rubrics_metrics.description: The Abstract shall disclose the essential features of the nature of the invention.

rubrics_metrics.name: Industrial design application: required documents (spec and photos/drawings)
rubrics_metrics.description: Documents identifying an industrial design shall contain a Specification of industrial design and a set of photos or drawings. Specification consists of a description and a scope of protection.

rubrics_metrics.name: Industrial design description: full disclosure and consistency with drawings
rubrics_metrics.description: The Description shall fully disclose features that express the nature of the industrial design and specify features that are new, different from the least different known industrial design, and be consistent with the photos or drawings.

rubrics_metrics.name: Industrial design description: variants and sets
rubrics_metrics.description: Where application consists of variants, description shall specify these variants and define distinctions between principal variant and others; where design is of a set of products, description shall specify features of each product.

rubrics_metrics.name: Industrial design scope of protection
rubrics_metrics.description: The Scope of protection of industrial design shall specify features claimed for protection, including features that are new and different from similar known industrial designs.

rubrics_metrics.name: Industrial design drawings/photos requirement
rubrics_metrics.description: The set of photos or drawings shall fully specify features of the industrial design.

rubrics_metrics.name: Layout-design application requirements
rubrics_metrics.description: Documents identifying a layout-design shall include drawings/photos of the layout-design; information on functions and structure of semiconductor integrated circuits produced by incorporation of the layout design; samples of a semiconductor IC produced by incorporation where layout design has been commercially exploited.

rubrics_metrics.name: Mark registration application: required documents and description
rubrics_metrics.description: Documents identifying the mark shall include samples of the mark and list of goods or services bearing the mark; rules on using collective mark or certification mark where applicable. The sample shall be described to clarify elements and comprehensive meaning; transliteration for hieroglyphic languages and translation for foreign languages required.

rubrics_metrics.name: Mark goods/services classification
rubrics_metrics.description: Goods or services listed in a mark application shall be classified in accordance with the Classification List under the Nice Agreement on International Classification of Goods and Services, published by the State administrative authority.

rubrics_metrics.name: Essential contents of rules for using a collective mark
rubrics_metrics.description: The rule shall contain: (a) designation, address, grounds of establishment and operations of the collective organization; (b) conditions to become a member; (c) list of organizations and individuals permitted to use the mark; (d) conditions for using the mark; (dd) remedies applicable to acts violating the rules.

rubrics_metrics.name: Essential contents of rules for using a certification mark
rubrics_metrics.description: The rule shall contain: (a) the organization or individual who is the mark owner; (b) conditions for using the mark; (c) characteristics of goods and services certified; (d) methods of evaluation and supervision of use; (dd) expenses payable by the mark user for certification and protection, if any.

rubrics_metrics.name: Geographical indication application: required documents/specimen
rubrics_metrics.description: Documents identifying the GI shall include: (a) the name or sign that is the GI; (b) the product bearing the GI; (c) description of peculiar characteristics or quality or reputation and characteristics of natural conditions attributing thereto; (d) the map of the geographical area; (d') documents evidencing protection in country of origin if foreign.

rubrics_metrics.name: GI description essential contents
rubrics_metrics.description: Descriptions of peculiar characteristics shall include: (a) description of relevant product including raw materials and physical/chemical/microbiological/perceptive characteristics; (b) methods for determination of geographical area; (c) evidence proving product originates from such area; (d) descriptions of local and stable production/processing methods; (dd) information on relationship between peculiar characteristics/reputation and natural conditions; (e) information on self-control mechanism of characteristics or quality.

rubrics_metrics.name: Power of attorney essential contents
rubrics_metrics.description: A power of attorney shall include: (a) full name and address of principal and attorney; (b) scope of authority; (c) validity term; (d) date; (dd) signature and seal (if any) of the principal. A power of attorney with no validity term is considered valid indefinitely until principal declares termination.

rubrics_metrics.name: Receiving applications: minimum documents for acceptance and filing date
rubrics_metrics.description: An application shall be received only if it includes at least: (a) a request including adequate information to identify the applicant and sample/list for marks; (b) specifications, photos/drawings, or descriptions as appropriate; (c) receipt of prescribed fees and charges. Filing date is date application is received by authority or international filing date for treaty filings.

rubrics_metrics.name: Formal examination: purpose
rubrics_metrics.description: Industrial property registration applications shall be examined as to form to verify their formal validity.

rubrics_metrics.name: Formal invalidity: non-fulfillment of formality requirements
rubrics_metrics.description: An application is not formally valid if it does not fulfill formality requirements.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Authority shall serve notice of intended refusal with reasons and time limit to overcome defects or to object; if applicant fails, notice of refusal to accept as formally valid shall be served.

rubrics_metrics.name: Formal invalidity: subject matter not eligible for protection
rubrics_metrics.description: An application is not formally valid if the subject matter of the application is not eligible for protection.

rubrics_metrics.name: Formal invalidity: applicant lacks right to registration
rubrics_metrics.description: An application is not formally valid if the applicant does not have the right to registration, including where the right belongs to more than one persons but one or several do not agree to execute the filing.

rubrics_metrics.name: Formal invalidity: incorrect filing mode under Article 89
rubrics_metrics.description: An application is not formally valid if it was filed contrary to the mode of filing provided for in Article 89 (e.g., foreign filer required to use representative).

rubrics_metrics.name: Formal invalidity: failure to pay fees and charges
rubrics_metrics.description: An application is not formally valid if the applicant fails to pay the fees and charges.

rubrics_metrics.name: Procedures following formal invalidity
rubrics_metrics.description: For applications falling under formal invalidity, the authority shall serve a notice of intended refusal specifying reasons and time to remedy or object; if not remedied or objected justifiably, serve notice of refusal to accept as formally valid. For layout-design registration applications, authority may serve notice of refusal to grant certificate.
